histamine.note: A classic liberator — common flare trigger.

nutrition.highlight: more vitamin C by weight than an orange

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.

effects.note: A smoothie mixing equal parts strawberry, blueberry, raspberry and blackberry improved executive function for several hours after drinking it in a controlled trial, plausibly through the same anthocyanin route credited to blueberry — though strawberry has less evidence on its own than blueberry does. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
